# Version Membership

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](gmeow-VersionMembership.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VersionMembership>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

A reified, standpoint-scoped claim that a concrete entity belongs to a version set with a particular role and/or scale — an observation in the universal claim stack. Mediates between an entity ([`versionMember`](../properties/gmeow-versionMember.md)), a version set ([`versionSet`](../properties/gmeow-versionSet.md)), and an optional role/scale asserted by an authority ([`membershipAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-membershipAuthority.md) / vantage). Mint one [`VersionMembership`](gmeow-VersionMembership.md) per (entity, [`versionSet`](../properties/gmeow-versionSet.md), role, authority) tuple; when a role changes over time, close the old membership's interval or mint a fresh one — never overwrite ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). Inherits confidence, displayable, and temporal scope from [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](gmeow-VersionMembership.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
